items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: He was playing with Count. We call him Fess.

ctx.x: Well, who did you hear when you were coming up though, I mean, before Hodges? You must have heard some different people when you were a kid here.
Well, we had like old Fess. I can't think of him. He's a New Orleans born too. He was playing with Count. We call him Fess. He died a while back.
